questions: Should the strings be sorted in ascending or descending order of length?
If two strings have the same length (though constraints say lengths are distinct), should the function handle it gracefully or assume it never occurs?
Should the sorting be stable with respect to the original input order when lengths are equal?
Is the output a single concatenated string without any separators, or should spaces or other characters be inserted between the sorted strings?
Should the function read input from standard input exactly as described, or can it take parameters like a list of strings?

Are the strings sorted based solely on length, or should they be sorted lexicographically after length? (The clarification says lexicographic comparison is never needed, but it might imply length-only sorting.)
Should the output include a newline character at the end?
Is the input guaranteed to have exactly N strings following the first line, or could there be extra whitespace or blank lines?
